title: Crunchy Kale Salad
description: A refreshing salad made with crunchy kale, jubilant and mediterranean flavors.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, massage the chopped kale with your hands for 2-3 minutes to make it tender.
2. Add the chopped crunchy, jubilant, and mediterranean salad to the bowl with the kale.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
4. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
